entries.effect: the class is there and names worlds as the release's does: +pageWorld and +defaultClientWorld are each one object for the process, +worldWithName: gives the same object back for the same name, and -name answers the name for a named world and nil for the two standard ones. What a world stands for - a separate JavaScript context - the release does not have: its UIWebView runs one context per frame, so scripts of every world share the page's globals
